purpose: Per board: when the academic year starts, when terms break, when board exams run, and when results land. Wobo uses this to know what season a learner is in before Wobo says anything.
law: Nothing in this file is invented. A date we could not read from an official source is null. A null means fetch it, not guess it. Anything marked provisional or tentative by the issuing authority carries that word here. No non-null date may cite a source registered as retrieved: not_retrieved; such a source may only carry nulls and re-anchor instructions.
